change.scope: ARM64 lowering of the compiler-generated private u32 four-lane horizontal combine only; no public SIMD API, checker, proof-admission, or register-allocator changes.
change.mechanism: Recognize the marked private array/store/exact four-lane sum; preserve the array AST as the verifier reference, emit ADDV into a fresh SIMD scratch, UMOV, and scalar seed addition. Reject escapes, extra identifier occurrences, other widths, floats, and unmarked lookalikes.
change.source_vector: Preserved, including when live after the scalar combine.
change.proof_gate: Existing asm.VerifyProven checks the emitted machine body against the original reference AST; the marker licenses recognition, never admission. This does not newly prove ADDV/UMOV correspondence to ARM ASL or complete the end-to-end chain.

provenance.note: Dirty emitter build includes this nativegen change and concurrent proof/test/docs changes. The harness hashed actual nonstandard compiler build inputs before and after preparation and required them unchanged. This is not a clean-checkout benchmark.
provenance.compiler_input_map_digest_recipe: sha256 of jq -cS '.compiler_source_sha256' prepared.json, including trailing newline

four_way_validation.oracle: Independent C, Rust, Zig, and Oak results checked against the shared C oracle and Python arbitrary-precision modular oracle.
four_way_validation.profile: Same sources and flags as the baseline report: C/Rust generic, Zig macOS baseline resolving to apple_m1 with NEON, macOS13 deployment minimum, no LTO. These are not identical feature sets or best-M4 profiles. Exact tool hashes and commands are retained in prepared.json.
four_way_validation.comparator_note: C and Rust object hashes match the baseline. Zig object bytes differ, with unchanged named-function instruction counts; no byte-identity claim is made for all comparator artifacts.

static_observations_not_performance_resu.method: Count instruction lines in each named function in the final shared-runner disassembly, including all paths; not dynamic instruction count or cycles.
static_observations_not_performance_resu.observation: The u32 final scratch-array store/reloads disappear. Callee-saved vector homes, saves/restores, and a nonzero frame remain. The u64 combine is unchanged.

stage2_regression.baseline_report: benchmarks/native/results/stage2-baseline-2026-09-25.json (integrated optimization result, not its initial pre-optimization artifact)
stage2_regression.os_note: The downstream checkout changed concurrently. The three scoped source files were hashed before emission and after conformance and were unchanged. This work made no downstream writes.
stage2_regression.verdict_note: Fresh checks include rejected alternatives, not additional selected bodies.

focused_validation.compiler_e2e: passed vector-reduction, reduction-liveness/tail, and float-SIMD coverage with OAK_VERIFY_CACHE=0
focused_validation.local_proof_tests: Free-vector/free-seed assembly checks, encoding, and VerifyProven; wrong-lane, omitted-seed, live-source clobber, and malformed-lane mutations produce Mismatch; privacy/escape/shape refusals and allocator-exhaustion cleanup tested.
focused_validation.other_widths: u32, u64, i32, and f32 generated loops remain Proven; only u32 selects ADDV.
focused_validation.concurrent_sail_helper_work: Full Sail Lean build passed 59 jobs, including STRConcreteHelpers with 13 exact standard-axiom guards. Required-oracle source/mutation tests and independent raw-export/freshness gates passed.
